clusters.headline: President Prabowo Consults Former Police Chiefs Amid Wiretap Probe
aiSummaryBullets: President Prabowo Subianto held a meeting with ten former National Police chiefs at his residence in Hambalang.
The National Police are currently investigating allegations of illegal wiretapping targeting the President and other prominent figures.

clusters.headline: President Prabowo Subianto Convenes Ten Former Police Chiefs Meeting
aiSummaryBullets: President Prabowo Subianto held a meeting with ten former National Police Chiefs at his residence in Hambalang.
The session included the current Minister of Home Affairs, Tito Karnavian, alongside other retired police leadership.

clusters.headline: Firefighting Helicopter Crew Member Recovered Deceased In Barito
aiSummaryBullets: A helicopter tasked with water bombing for forest and land fires crashed into the Barito River in South Kalimantan.
Two crew members, reported to be foreign nationals, survived the incident, while one Indonesian crew member was confirmed dead.

clusters.headline: Authorities Investigate East Jakarta Mosque Assault Incident
aiSummaryBullets: Three worshippers were injured during an attack at the Darul Ma'arif Mosque in Pondok Kelapa, East Jakarta, during Subuh prayers.
Law enforcement officials are investigating the incident and the motivation behind the suspect's actions.

clusters.headline: Marco Bezzecchi Wins MotoGP Qatar 2026 With Marquez Finishing Second
aiSummaryBullets: Marco Bezzecchi claimed first place at the 2026 MotoGP event in Qatar.
Marc Marquez secured the second position at the Lusail International Circuit.

clusters.headline: Poland Updates Death Toll To Nine In Deadly Krakow Shooting Event
aiSummaryBullets: The death toll from the shooting in Krakow, Poland, has risen to nine individuals.
Authorities identified the victims to include members of the perpetrator's family.

clusters.headline: Indonesian Traffic Police Deny Reports Of Lifetime Drivers Licenses
aiSummaryBullets: The Indonesian National Police Traffic Corps clarified that drivers licenses do not have lifetime validity.
Current regulations maintain that drivers licenses must be renewed every five years.

clusters.headline: Fire Damages Damri Bus Depot In Bandung Affecting Multiple Vehicles
aiSummaryBullets: A fire broke out at a Damri bus depot located on Jalan Kebon Kawung in Bandung, West Java, on November 8.
The incident resulted in the destruction of ten inactive buses and caused damage to thirteen surrounding residential homes.

clusters.headline: Officials Estimate Gambir Station Fire Damage At 200 Million Rupiah
aiSummaryBullets: Regional disaster management agencies estimated the fire damage to reach 200 million rupiah.
Fire and rescue services identified electrical issues as the suspected cause of the incident.

clusters.headline: Electrical Short Circuit Triggers Residential Fire In North Jakarta
aiSummaryBullets: A residential building in Kebon Bawang, North Jakarta, caught fire on Sunday evening.
Initial reports indicate the incident was caused by an electrical short circuit within the home.
